scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const parts=fs.readdirSync('.').filter(f=>f.startsWith('source.part')).sort();const b64=parts.map(f=>fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8')).join('').replace(/\s+/g,'');fs.writeFileSync('source.tgz',Buffer.from(b64,'base64'));" && (gzip -dc source.tgz > source.tar || true) && echo '--- tar bytes ---' && wc -c source.tar && echo '--- recoverable entries ---' && (tar --ignore-zeros -tf source.tar || true) && echo '--- extracting ---' && (tar --ignore-zeros -xf source.tar || true) && echo '--- recovered files ---' && find app components lib -type f 2>/dev/null | sort && echo '--- globals ---' && (wc -c app/globals.css || true) && exit 1
